ALTER VIEW [EDS].[Employment_Information] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
WHERE
--- Last n business days
    RN <= Rolling_Window
)
SELECT
RW.FullDate AS AS_OF_DATE,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.EMPLOYMENT_STATUS AS EMPLOYMENT_STATUS,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.INCOME_NATURE AS INCOME_NATURE,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT2 AS STRTEXT2,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT9 AS STRTEXT9,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.EMPLOYERID AS EMPLOYERID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT4 AS STRTEXT4,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DTDATE1 AS DTDATE1,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT3 AS STRTEXT3,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT17 AS STRTEXT17,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT25 AS STRTEXT25,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.USERFIELD8 AS USERFIELD8,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME AS ANNUAL_SALARY_INCOME,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SALALLOWANCES AS SALALLOWANCES,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME AS ANNUAL_OTHERS_INCOME,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME AS ANNUAL_RENTAL_INCOME,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.VACANCYFACTOR AS VACANCYFACTOR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES AS BONUSCOMMISSIONSINCENTIVES,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.OVERTIMEINCOME AS OVERTIMEINCOME,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.TOTALESTACCOUNTVALUE AS TOTALESTACCOUNTVALUE,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SALOTHERINCOME2 AS SALOTHERINCOME2,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SALOTHERINCOME3 AS SALOTHERINCOME3,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.TOTALHOUSEHOLDINCM AS TOTALHOUSEHOLDINCM,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPTAXRETURNFIELD AS SELFEMPTAXRETURNFIELD,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPGROSSRECIPTCURRENTYR AS SELFEMPGROSSRECIPTCURRENTYR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPGROSSRECEIPTPRIORYEAR AS SELFEMPGROSSRECEIPTPRIORYEAR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPNETPROFITCURRENTYR AS SELFEMPNETPROFITCURRENTYR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPNETPROFITPRIORYR AS SELFEMPNETPROFITPRIORYR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPDEPRECIATIONCURRENTYEAR AS SELFEMPDEPRECIATIONCURRENTYEAR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPDEPRECIATIONPRIORYEAR AS SELFEMPDEPRECIATIONPRIORYEAR,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SELFEMPAVERAGEANNUALTURNOVER AS SELFEMPAVERAGEANNUALTURNOVER,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT5 AS STRTEXT5,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT6 AS STRTEXT6,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT28 AS STRTEXT28,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT18 AS STRTEXT18,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT20 AS STRTEXT20,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT21 AS STRTEXT21,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT19 AS STRTEXT19,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT7 AS STRTEXT7,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT8 AS STRTEXT8,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.DEMOGRAPHICID AS DEMOGRAPHICID,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY AS ORGKEY,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.TYPE AS TYPE,
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ACCOUNTID AS ACCOUNTID
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC AS CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC
	    ON CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
---Fetch all records per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'SNAPSHOT' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'DELTA' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.SCD_Start_Date))
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO AS CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO
        ON CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.Type = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
        AND CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY AND CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.BANK_ID = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID
        AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL 
---Fetch all records that per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'SNAPSHOT' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (UPPER(RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA) = 'DELTA' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date))
        
WHERE 
CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL AND
(CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL OR CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY IS NOT NULL);
GO
